text_block_list.text: The day before the Osaka Hai—

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Next stop is Nagoya, Nagoya.
After departing Nagoya, we will stop at Kyoto and Shin-Osaka—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...The time of "arrival" at Shin-Osaka is...
"16:57"—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Neo... Universe?
What a coincidence...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, there's none.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative.
Because we are "fellow passengers."

On the Osaka Hai roster was the name of Neo Universe,
the Double Crown Umamusume who won both
the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby last year.

Since we're running in the same race, it's
completely plausible that we'd end up on the same Shinkansen.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai is... the celestial junction with Admire Groove. And—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: In the next Tenno Sho (Spring), Neo Universe will achieve... "orbital resonance".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
What did you say...?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……will step away from "running."
――Shifting to "observer."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—...? Step away... from running...?
Are you... retiring?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (What does this mean...? Not retiring...? But stepping away from running...?)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe has... "observed."
Through the "window"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Unless we cross the "singularity"...
we cannot "interfere" with the "window".

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean?
I don't... really understand.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: But... there is plenty of "HPNS".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
'Sharing' with a friend... 'Moon viewing'—
"Mem"... each and every one is a 'treasure.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Neo Universe wants to... 'observe' lots of... 'mem'.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Even if you have to step away from racing for some reason, you still want to make precious memories... is that it?)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: What kind of "window" does Admire Groove... want to "observe"...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If you desire it, you can do it.
Yes—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even a 'connection'—to the future.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Connecting... to the origin...

—The day of the Osaka Hai. Air Groove and Duramente
had come to offer their support.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Dura, watch closely.
Watch how Alve runs.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, Sis Groove.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Alv-senpai—
Please have your best race out there.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I will be sure to learn from your running in Senior-year GⅠs,
as well as your spirit."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I don't rely on anyone,
and nobody relies on me.
That's how I thought, for a very long time...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(In the midst of that, I had only honed my strength
for the sake of my own self-fulfillment, but...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This power... could it be used
for someone else's sake too?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (But after all this time...)

Admire Groove's feelings still drift in limbo.
If that is the case—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Show you"... what, exactly?
A flawless victory?
No, even more than that—
choice_data_list: What I'll be running for from here on out...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What do I... run for...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(This person... Trainer has
always watched every step I've taken.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(If they're the one asking...
then it must have a purpose...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Now all that remains... is what I desire.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Shall I proceed in solitary pride, or—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Or is it—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: âWatch me, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If my feelings can take shape...
I'm sure they will dwell within my running, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Groove...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: The curtain rises, Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphira, that's right...

Coincidentally, they debuted in the same week.
Their paths had not crossed since, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Finally.
Let's both give it our absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Last year's Triple Crown route and Triple Tiara route.
Carrying the pride of leading their respective paths.
